description: This header file defines data structures and function prototypes for managing malfunction/error codes within the firmware. It includes functions to initialize, add, remove, set, and retrieve error codes, as well as check for existing errors.

methods.name: initMalfunctionCentral
methods.description: Initializes the malfunction central module, likely resetting error codes and preparing data structures.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds an error code to the set of current malfunction/error codes.

methods.name: removeError
methods.description: Removes an error code from the current set.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets or clears an error state based on the boolean flag.

methods.name: getErrorCodes
methods.description: Copies current error codes into a provided buffer.

methods.name: hasErrorCodes
methods.description: Returns true if there are any current error codes.
